children: Ivanhoe Electric released an S-K 1300 Preliminary Feasibility Study for the Santa Cruz Copper Project showing a $1.52B after-tax NPV (8%) and 18.7% IRR.
2026 PFS for Santa Cruz Copper Project published under S-K 1300; replaces the June 23, 2025 technical report.
After-tax NPV (8%) of $1.52B and after-tax IRR of 18.7%; payback 4.8 years after operations begin.
Total life-of-mine capital cost $2.85B (initial $1.43B; sustaining $1.42B); total LOM operating costs $4.53B.
Probable Mineral Reserves: 140.13 Mt at 1.08% Cu (1,519 kt contained copper); mine life 24 years; avg LOM copper production ~58,385 t/y.
Average C1 cash cost $1.47/lb Cu; average LOM recovery to cathode 92.3%; production target ~75,000 t/y for first 15 years.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
